objective: Find a self-serve/passive revenue opportunity where buyer intent already exists in a marketplace/search channel; avoid client-by-client outreach. Market/buyer/pain/payment evidence must come before building.

must_have: Existing buyer demand / willingness to pay
Product quality can be verified deterministically
Can be built with current engineering stack without heavy proprietary data licensing
avoid: Generic AI/content APIs with weak proprietary data
Markets already nativeized by the platform
Opportunities that require heavy manual support to function
Short-lived deadline/event opportunities unless edge is unusually strong

current_benchmark.candidate: B2B Purchase Order / PDF -> Shopify Draft Order
current_benchmark.buyer: Shopify wholesalers, distributors, manufacturers receiving purchase orders by PDF/Excel/CSV/email
current_benchmark.pain: Staff manually re-key SKU, quantity, customer and order data from incoming POs into Shopify; high line-count POs consume substantial labor and create entry-error risk.

market_evidence.traction_signal: 18 reviews, all 5-star at time of research
review_signals: Merchant reported processing a 100+ line PO in under 4 minutes
Merchant reported roughly halving PO entry time
Multiple reviews praise onboarding/support and custom override fixes
direct_competitors_seen: POMate - new entrant, low/no review traction at checkpoint
DraftGenius - low/no review traction at checkpoint
ReorderInbox - very new/low/no review traction at checkpoint

why_it_is_interesting: Only one clearly proven incumbent found in direct niche
Pain is operational and recurring, not cosmetic
Shopify App Store provides buyer-intent distribution
current_benchmark.core_product_principle: Never guess. Every parsed line must map source text -> matched SKU/UPC -> quantity -> confidence. Ambiguous/low-confidence rows are blocked rather than silently matched.
initial_scope: Create Shopify Draft Order only after validation
do_not_scope_initially: Free-form inference that can silently invent SKU matches

benchmark_before_building_full_app.decision_rule: If benchmark cannot meet these thresholds, drop the idea rather than list a mediocre parser.

eliminated_or_downgraded.reason: Current API/data quality is not strong/proprietary enough to justify buyer payment; engineering ability to expose an endpoint is not a moat.

eliminated_or_downgraded.candidate: Generic SEO / Google Trends / keyword APIs
eliminated_or_downgraded.reason: Strong demand but commodity/price-war competition and entrenched providers.
Interesting market but current stack lacks sufficiently reliable multi-LLM observation access to deliver the core product well.
Very passive distribution but broad categories are heavily saturated and Creator approval/portfolio quality adds friction.

eliminated_or_downgraded.candidate: WordPress + Cloudflare R2 private media / WooCommerce secure downloads
eliminated_or_downgraded.reason: Broad offload competition is already strong; secure Woo niche appears too small; restore/re-hydrate is a useful feature but likely too small as a standalone business.

eliminated_or_downgraded.candidate: Shopify EU B2B VAT validator / automatic tax exemption
eliminated_or_downgraded.reason: Core VAT validation/reverse-charge functionality has been nativeized by Shopify Tax, reducing the opportunity.
Real demand but shutdown window is too short and incumbent replacement already has strong traction.
Multiple new entrants are rapidly attacking the same gap; edge is shrinking.
Simple to build but market appears too small/low-ARPU.

eliminated_or_downgraded.candidate: EU Withdrawal Button / similar compliance widgets
eliminated_or_downgraded.reason: Existing incumbents already have substantial traction.
Large demand/deadline but legal/integration risk and competition from approved-platform ecosystems make it less passive and harder to guarantee.
Several entrants already appeared quickly; category becoming a race.
Competition increasing quickly and quality/liability burden is higher.

research_process_rule: Do not code a full product yet. Continue market search and only replace the current #1 benchmark if a candidate has stronger payment evidence, lower strong-competitor density, and equal or better self-serve/passive characteristics. If no better candidate appears, validate the PO->Draft Order parser benchmark first.
next_research_target: Continue scanning Shopify App Store, WordPress Plugin Directory and Chrome Web Store for deterministic operational pains with marketplace buyer intent, using the current B2B PO->Shopify Draft Order opportunity as the minimum benchmark to beat.
